sp-acj4-1-cond

Given
\(x \in \mathbb{R},\quad \left|x\right| \le 1\)
Claim
\(\displaystyle \arcsin\left(\left|x\right|\right) = \left|\arcsin x\right|\)
Expected
true equal at every admissible point

the two sides are equal at every admissible point

SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[1] + rules.json[0]: asin abs _0 -> abs asin _0 [weakest assumption found: abs-le-1]

Lean proof: included

(case sp-acj4-1-cond (category simplipy-conditional)
  (note "SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[1] + rules.json[0]: asin abs _0  ->  abs asin _0  [weakest assumption found: abs-le-1]")
  (var x real)
  (assume (<= (abs x) 1))
  (ask (= (asin (abs x)) (abs (asin x))))
  (expect true)
  (lean-proof "obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := AE.IsReal.exists hd0; have hr : |r| ≤ 1 := (by simpa [AE.abs_ofReal] using h0.2); have hr' := abs_le.mp hr; refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩; rw [AE.abs_ofReal, AE.asin_ofReal (by linarith [abs_nonneg r]) hr, AE.asin_ofReal hr'.1 hr'.2, AE.abs_ofReal, AE.cond_arcsin_abs]"))

sp-acj4-108-condf

Given
\(x \in \mathbb{C},\quad x \in i\mathbb{R},\quad x \neq 0,\quad \left|x\right| \neq 0\)
Claim
\(\displaystyle \frac{\left|x\right|}{x} \neq \frac{x}{\left|x\right|}\)
Expected
false unequal at every admissible point (e.g. at \(x = i\))

the two sides differ at every admissible point

witness (false): \(x = i\)

SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[108] + rules.json[87]: / abs _0 _0 -> / _0 abs _0 [false under: imaginary]

Lean proof: included

(case sp-acj4-108-condf (category simplipy-conditional)
  (note "SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[108] + rules.json[87]: / abs _0 _0  ->  / _0 abs _0  [false under: imaginary]")
  (var x complex)
  (assume (imaginary x))
  (assume (nonzero x))
  (assume (nonzero (abs x)))
  (ask (= (/ (abs x) x) (/ x (abs x))))
  (expect false)
  (witness false (x i))
  (lean-proof "exact AE.w2_c108 x h0 h1 h2"))

sp-acj4-124-condf

Given
\(x \in \mathbb{C},\quad x \in i\mathbb{R},\quad \cosh x \neq 0\)
Claim
\(\displaystyle \left|\arcsin\left(\tanh x\right)\right| \overset{?}{=} \arccos\left(\frac{1}{\cosh x}\right)\)
Expected
contingent true at \(x = 2 \, \pi \, i\); false at \(x = i\)

equal at some admissible points, different at others

witness (true): \(x = 2 \, \pi \, i\)

witness (false): \(x = i\)

SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[124]: abs asin tanh !0 -> acos inv cosh !0 [false under: imaginary]; relabelled contingent: true at x = (* 2 pi i) (a probe the random samples miss)

Lean proof: included

(case sp-acj4-124-condf (category simplipy-conditional)
  (note "SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[124]: abs asin tanh !0  ->  acos inv cosh !0  [false under: imaginary]; relabelled contingent: true at x = (* 2 pi i) (a probe the random samples miss)")
  (var x complex)
  (assume (imaginary x))
  (assume (nonzero (cosh x)))
  (ask (= (abs (asin (tanh x))) (acos (/ (cosh x)))))
  (expect contingent)
  (witness true (x (* 2 pi i)) (lean-proof "exact AE.w3_c124_w1"))
  (witness false (x i) (lean-proof "exact AE.w3_c124_w2")))
